# shumoku_credential (Resource)

A server-wide device credential (for example an SNMP community) and the topologies that use it. Requires an `admin` API token.

Secret parameters are write-only on the server: it reports which secret keys hold a value (`secrets_set`) but never the values, so `secret_params` is kept from configuration and a change made outside Terraform cannot be detected, except a secret that was cleared.

The server deduplicates credentials: creating one whose method and parameters (secrets included) equal an existing credential's links the topologies to the existing one instead. This resource refuses that case, undoes the links it caused, and asks you to import the existing credential.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "snmp_community" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "shumoku_credential" "campus_snmp" {
  name   = "Campus SNMP"
  method = "snmp"
  secret_params = {
    community = var.snmp_community
  }
  topology_ids = [shumoku_topology.campus.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `method` (String) Access method id, e.g. `snmp`. Changing it forces a new credential.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Unique name. When omitted the server picks one (`SNMP 1`, `SNMP 2`, ...).
- `params` (Map of String) Non-secret parameters of the method. The `snmp` method has none today. The server keeps a stored value when a key is omitted, so removing a key does not clear it.
- `secret_params` (Map of String, Sensitive) Secret parameters of the method, e.g. `{ community = "..." }` for `snmp`. Write-only on the server; stored in Terraform state (mark your inputs sensitive). A secret is never cleared by removing it here.
- `topology_ids` (Set of String) Ids of the topologies that use this credential: the full set. Removing a topology un-assigns the credential from that topology's devices. When omitted, the links are not managed (whatever the server has is kept).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Creation time, Unix milliseconds.
- `id` (String) Server-generated credential id (`cr_...`).
- `secret_changed_at` (Number) When the parameter values last changed, Unix milliseconds.
- `secrets_set` (Set of String) Keys of the secret parameters that hold a value on the server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A credential is imported by its id (cr_...). Secret parameters cannot be read
# back: after the import, the next apply writes secret_params from configuration.
terraform import shumoku_credential.campus_snmp <credential_id>
```
